Yes.

Have been using these for about 3 years now! I dont ever buy anything else, they feel cool when places on skin and you can feel the tightness whne you take them off, makes you feel refresh and clean! I juat wish they would sell bigger packs

Only used one time, but saw result immediately. I plan to follow the recommendation of 2-3 times per week going forward.

These do Exactly what they say they will do! I pop these on in the morning just before I start my eye makeup for the day. I don't go as high as one of the pictures I saw in the reviews...I leave just enough room to do my liner/shadow on my lower lids. I have them on for a good 30-40 minutes and when I remove them I look like I got a great night's sleep, even when I didn't. I get full coverage of my under eye area. They are large enough where I can't imagine anybody at all having an issue with this. They say firmly in place, no slipping or sliding, even tho there is more than enough serum on them. They definitely have not dried out completely when I remove them. Since these are used immediately after I wash my face I always keep a set for the next day and after applying a caffeine based serum I put the same set back on so that I get 2 days of use with each pair. Once again, no issue with them not staying in place. I've Always had a problem with getting enough sleep at night...I try bur it just doesn't happen but because of these patches nobody would ever know that I'm a night owl. Highly recommend adding these to your morning regimine!

I don't write reviews often, but these eye patches warranted it. After an overindulgent night, and waking up in the morning with puffy , dark, dry wrinkly eyes, I slapped these patches on & 30 minutes later , my under eye area looked refreshed! I wish I would've taken before & after pics, it was that noticeable. I cant say how long it's lasted, but for two bucks , it's worth it even for a temporary fix! I wish they made these for lids !
they do make your under eye bags look not as dark and do help with dark circles.
I have tried several different brands & these are by far my favorite. I always come back for more. Don't get me started on the scent… heavenly ✨

These are my favorite under eye patches, they stay in place for as long as you want them. I put them on in the morning and drive 45 minutes to work and when I arrive they are always still sticking. They are moisturizing and help my puffy morning eyes.
these stay on really well & I really think they help with puffiness!!

Earth Therapeutics is my favorite brand in Ulta for full sheet masks. So, when I saw these for the under eye area, I had to try them. Like all patches the results don't last forever, but nice when your under eye looks a little extra worn out or when you're meeting the girls for lunch and want to look your best.

avis.titre: Good under-eye patch, especially for the young
avis.texte: I have used at least five, 5-patch boxes of the Earth Therapeutics Collagen Hydrogel Under-Eye Patch, purchased both online and in an Ulta store. I am middle aged, and well into declining facial collagen. I look like I care well for my skin for my age, but pore size, very fine lines, and skin elasticity is not what it used to be. These patches are good for refreshing tired eyes, moisturizing, and slightly plumping the under-eye area. As a result, I notice a temporary smoothing of the finest of my fine lines. I think for the price point, I might purchase them again to at least get some results when on a budget. My preference is to pay a little more for under-eye patches with a little more effectiveness for older eyes. I imagine they would be very effective for the needs of people in their twenties and thirties, for refreshing and moisturizing tired eyes, perhaps after a late night. I did not find them to be particularly effective for middle-aged tired eyes and puffiness.

The only positive thing I can say about this product is that the patches created a nice cooling sensation under my eyes for the 30 minutes I was wearing them. Unfortunately, the patches not only failed to diminish my under eye bags, but they increased the size. Immediately after peeling off the patches, my eyes were more puffy than before the treatment. Nice, just what I wanted, additional baggage!

Meh. I was underwhelmed. I used these twice a week for a month and there is no real change in the circles or puffiness under my eyes. I'm 42 and JUST noticed the circles. Was hoping for a miracle. This was NOT it!

I use some eye cream & these for 10 minutes, then apply a little more eye cream after removing. It really smooths out fine lines and makes my undereyes less puffy. Amazing difference! I wish I could afford to use them everyday, but every 2-3 days works well, too. I rarely repurchase anything, but these really work for me!
Smells like oranges and didn't have any problem staying on my eyes. I was able to do small things around the house with the patches.

I buy this product often- it does exactly what it says; the patches smooth out under-eye bags/puffiness and fine lines. The effects are temporary, but it definitely works well. I leave them on for quite a while when I can, not just 15 minutes as the instruction say. The patches feel soothing and have a nice scent.

avis.titre: Eyes Looked Brighter After One Use

I started to notice a day or two after each use that at the tops of my cheeks yellow bags (festoons) would start to show. I denied at first that it could be related, but after some trial, it definitely seems to be these patches that draw them out.
Love these eye patches! So smoothing. I have multiple issues with my eye area. Such as dark circles, puffiness at times. Etc... These eye patches in my opinion works great. Two thumbs up!

I've been using these patches for a few weeks now every day in the morning. I like them. It feels great and my eyes have been noticably more hydrated. I use a bit of the ordinary serum right before I apply. I'll continue to repurchase :)

avis.titre: Triple Threat: Eye Serum, Eye Cream & an ET Eye Mask
avis.texte: I am a 48 y/o WOC fighting with dark circles. Now more like a dark intermittent line. I am using eye serum, eye cream and now eye masks 2x day in am and pm routines. I use this after skin care regimen completed and while doing eye prep and shadow. At night apply before bed after night regimen for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Eye area looks better, less dark and fading, concealer doesn't crack, can go without concealer, and I look younger and better rested. I have prestige eye masks for special occasions but I use these from ET daily. Like chewing gum, I always have extra. I don't look like a Walking Dead zombie around the eyes anymore or a rabid raccoon with dehydration. It takes work, effort, and time to do this consistently but this is a war with aging and the eyes are but one battle:) No breakouts from Triple Threat method as my skin is mature. Cost is reasonable and I have slapped one of ET eye masks on after a workout cleansing, on an airplane, etc. I keep these in the fridge and apply my eye masks cool and adding to the pampering. If you struggle with lines, circles, bags, wrinkles other eye stuff try it!

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product I used these RELIGIOUSLY

I don't have a huge issue with dark circles so I can't speak to that claim, but these were refreshing and my under eyes felt more hydrated and smooth after use. I'd buy them again.

These under-eye patches did slightly improve my puffy under-eyes, making the bags slightly less puffy and noticeable. The skin looked a little tighter and more like I'd gotten enough sleep. They stick well and make the area feel hydrated after removing them. I felt like they improved the appearance of the saggy skin under my eyes, and will definitely buy them again. They don't work miracles, but definitely provide improvement. They feel good and make me feel refreshed.

avis.titre: Improves under-eye, but scented & doesn't stick well to skin
avis.texte: I was looking for a decent under-eye mask. This one has decent reviews. I can definitely see some improvement in my under-eye area, and I will definitely use the rest of the product but I don't think I would buy again. I did not expect a product that is supposed to sit under your eye for 30 minutes to be scented. The scent isn't super potent, and it could legitimately be a result of the ingredients used in the product. Additionally, masks for the under-eye area are meant to stay on your skin for roughly 20 - 30m. Typically, with other products I will do other things while waiting on the 30m timer without any issue. When I was trying this product for the first time I did other things while waiting on the timer. With that said, I DO NOT recommend doing anything other than sitting and relaxing while this is on your face. The product will begin to separate from your under-eye skin, but it can be padded back down with clean fingers. Result wise: I can definitely see an improvement in my under-eye area and I have only used it once -- which is why it is getting 4/5 stars. If you do use this product be aware of your own personal scent sensitivity, and plan to do nothing but sit and relax. Maybe soak in the bath while you wait?

I love these gels they are the best kind of gel patch in my opinion. love sticking these on my drive to work and feeling cool and refreshed for my day when I park and walk to my office

Only gave 4 stars because I'm looking for a miracle when it comes to my dark circles. But I will continue to use these a few times a week and maybe I'll see an improvement.

avis.titre: softens creases, depuffs. tightens better than most!!

Hydrogel Collagen Under Eye Patch are okay so for, would like to see more effect around the eyes. The patches feels nice.

I was surprised to find out that the patches were not sopping wet. I liked the cloth material on the outside of the patch. The gel on the underside is very comfortable, and has a light citrus scent. I find that I keep them in longer than the recommended 30 minutes. I've contemplated sleeping in them. They are easy to remove, and I can feel a light substance left on the skin. I truly enjoy these patches, and I plan on continuing to buy them to use in a regular basis. I don't have any specific under eye issues, but I am using them to be proactive as I age.
